topic: Asking the Clinic for a Doctor's Note for Work

script.title: A NOTE FOR WORK
script.scene_zh: 診所櫃台 · 補開證明
script.story_hook: Three sick days gone; now the boss wants proof.
script.intro_zh: 病癒要返崗，人資還要有白紙黑字的證明。
script.welcome_en: Hey there, welcome to today's clinic desk. Listen for polite requests and answers.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的診所櫃台。留意有禮貌的要求與回應。
script.outro: The note's sorted, paycheck safe. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 證明搞定，薪水也穩了。再聽一遍，跟著一起說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: My boss wants it in writing
script.char_a_description: a heavyset man in his thirties with a shaved head, thick black-framed glasses, a rumpled light blue dress shirt with a loosened navy tie, an employee badge on a lanyard, and a tired but polite expression
script.char_b_description: a peppy young woman in her early twenties with a chin-length ash-blonde bob, cat-eye glasses, a maroon clinic vest over a crisp white shirt, small pearl studs, and a petite build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, um, I was sick last week? Need a note.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ʌm aɪ wəz sɪkst læst wik nid ə noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，嗯，我上週病了好幾天？需要一張醫生證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You came to the right desk, I handle those.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju keɪm tə ðə raɪt dɛs aɪ ˈhændəl ðoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 您來對地方了，這種單子就是我負責。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. I need a doctor's note for work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪ nid ə ˈdɑktɚz ˈnoʊt fɚ wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我需要一張公司要用的醫生證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Did you see Dr. Patel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ θɪŋ dɪd ju si ˈdɑkɚ pəˈteɪl/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，您看的是帕托爾醫師，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, Tuesday morning, the sore throat thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈtuzdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ðə ˈsɔɹ θɹoʊt θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，週二早上，就是喉嚨痛那一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me pull your file… yes, I see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi pʊl jɔɹ ˈfaɪl jɛs aɪ si ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我調一下您的病歷……看到了，就在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My boss wants it in writing, by Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bɔs wɑnts ɪt ɪn ˈɹaɪtɪŋ baɪ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我老闆要白紙黑字的，星期五之前要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can do that, no problem at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən du ðæt noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm ət ˈɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我們辦得到，完全不是問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, relieved. What exactly does the note say?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɹɪˈlid wʌt ɪɡˈzæktli dʌz ðə noʊt seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，鬆口氣。證明上具體會寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dates you were seen, and you're cleared.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə deɪts ju wɜɹ sind ænd jʊɹ kilɚd/
dialogue.zh: 您就診的日期，還有您康復可回崗的許可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cleared? I still can't lift heavy boxes, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪrd aɪ stɪl kænt lɪft ˈhɛvi ˈbɑksəz ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 回崗？其實我現在還搬不了重箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, then we add a restriction line for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðɛn wi æd ə rɪˈstrɪkʃən laɪn fɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 啊，那我們就在單子上加一行限制。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! The warehouse has a twenty-pound limit rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈwɛɹˌhaʊz hæz ə ˈtwɛnti ˈpaʊnd ˈlɪmət ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 對！倉庫有規定，單次不能超過二十磅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll write: no lifting over twenty pounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɹaɪt noʊ ˈlɪftɪŋ ˈoʊvɚ ˈtwɛnti ˈpaʊndz/
dialogue.zh: 我來寫：禁止搬舉超過二十磅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For two weeks, that's what the doctor said.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ tu wiːks ðæts wʌt ðə ˈdɑktɚ sɛd/
dialogue.zh: 兩個星期，醫生是這麼交代的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks starting Tuesday, correct?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiːks ˈstɑɹɾɪŋ ˈtuzdeɪ kɚˈɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 從那天週二算起兩週，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, was it Tuesday or Monday, um…
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wəz ɪt ˈtuzdeɪ ɔɹ ˈmʌndeɪ ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 等等，是週二還是週一，嗯……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your visit stamp says Tuesday, the eleventh.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ ˈvɪzɪt stæmp sɛz ˈtuzdeɪ ði ɪˈlɛvənθ/
dialogue.zh: 您的看診章蓋的是週二，十一號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday then. My brain is still foggy, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzdeɪ ðɛn maɪ breɪn ɪz stɪl ˈfɑɡi hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 那就是週二。我腦袋還糊糊的，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three sick days will do that, for sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi sɪk deɪz wɪl du ðæt fɚ ˈʃɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 病上三天都會這樣，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. Does the note mention my throat thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu dʌz ðə noʊt ˈmɛnʃən maɪ θɹoʊt θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是。證明會提到我喉嚨的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we never write diagnosis details, privacy.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wi ˈnɛvɚ ɹaɪt ˌdaɪəɡˈnoʊsəs dɪˈteɪlz ˈpɹaɪvəsi/
dialogue.zh: 不會，診斷細節我們從不寫，這是隱私。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? My manager asked me for the reason.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹiəli maɪ ˈmænədʒɚ əskt mi fɚ ðə ˈɹizən/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我主管還問我生病的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He doesn't get that, honestly, that's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi dʌznt ɡɛt ðæt ˈɑnəstli ðæts ðə ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，他不該知道，這是規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh. So HR just gets dates and limits?
dialogue.phonetic: /hə soʊ eɪtʃ ɑɹ dʒʌst ɡɛts deɪts ænd ˈlɪməts/
dialogue.zh: 喔。那人資只會拿到日期和限制？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly: you were here, you're excused, restrictions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ju wɜɹ hɪɹ jʊɹ ɪkˈskjuzd rɪˈstrɪkʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯：您來過、病假核准了、有搬重物限制。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's actually a relief too. Is there a fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈæktʃuəli ə ɹɪˈlif tu ɪz ðɛr ə fim/
dialogue.zh: 這樣也讓人安心。開這張要收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First note is free, copies cost two dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst noʊt ɪz fɹi ˈkɑpiz kɑst tu ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 第一張免費，多一張兩塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. Can I get two copies, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ kən aɪ ɡɛt tu ˈkɑpiz baɪ ðə ˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 合理。順便問，我可以要兩張複本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, one to the office, one to keep?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs wʌn tə ðə ˈɔfəs wʌn tə kip/
dialogue.zh: 當然，一張交公司，一張自己留？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, in case they misplace it somewhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɪn keɪs ðeɪ mɪsˈpleɪs ɪt ˈsʌmˌwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這個意思，萬一他們弄丟，我還有備份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Now, paper pickup or email today?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt naʊ ˈpeɪpɚ ˈpɪkˌʌp ɔɹ ˈimeɪl təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。那您要紙本自取，還是今天發信？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email? Can you send it right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈimeɪl kən ju sɛnd ɪt ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 發信？你們現在就能寄出去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If you sign a release, sure, why not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ju saɪn ə ɹɪˈlis sɜɹ waɪ ˈnɑt/
dialogue.zh: 只要您簽一封授權書，就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, send it to me or to HR?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt sɛnd ɪt tə mi ɔɹ tə eɪtʃ ɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，是寄到我這裡，還是寄到人資？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: HR directly, it looks more official that way.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪtʃ ɑɹ dəˈɹɛktli ɪts lʊks mɔɹ əˈfɪʃəl ðæt ˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 直接寄到人資那頭，那樣看起來更正式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, good point. Where do I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɡʊd pɔɪnt wɛɹ du aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，有道理。我在哪裡簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This form, name, date, and the office email.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs fɔɹm neɪm deɪt ænd ði ˈɔfəs ˈimeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 這張表，姓名、日期，還有公司信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their email is… do you have it saved?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ˈimeɪl ɪz du ju hæv ɪt seɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 他們的信箱是……你們系統有存嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You wrote it on intake, let me check… yep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɹɑt ɪt ɑn ˈɪnteɪk lɛt mi tʃɛk jɛp/
dialogue.zh: 您報到時自己寫過，我找一下……有了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small wins, ha. One issue though, today's Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wɪnz hɑ wʌn ˈɪʃu ðoʊ təˈdeɪz ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 小確幸，哈。不過有個問題，今天是星期五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! We close at four, it's three fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ wi kloʊz æt fɔɹ ɪts θɹi ˈfɪftin/
dialogue.zh: 噢！我們四點關門，現在三點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the email goes out today, still?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ði ˈimeɪl ɡoʊz aʊt təˈdeɪ stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 所以郵件今天還是發得出去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but paper pickup has to wait for Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ˈpeɪpɚ ˈpɪkˌʌp hæz tə weɪt fɚ ˈmʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 發得出，但紙本自取要等到週一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday… okay, my weekend plan survives, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌndeɪ oʊˈkeɪ maɪ ˈwikˌɛnd plæn sɚˈvaɪvz hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 週一……好吧，我的週末計畫還能存活，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely! It's flu season, everyone wants notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛɹli ɪts flu ˈsizən ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn wɑnts noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 勉強算！正值流感季，人人都要證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bet. Can I pay the two dollars now?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɛt kən aɪ peɪ ðə tu ˈdɑlərz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我猜也是。那兩塊錢我現在可以付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card reader's right here, tap or insert.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ˈɹidɚz ɹaɪt hɪɹ tæp ɔɹ ˈɪnsɜɹt/
dialogue.zh: 讀卡機就在這，輕碰或插卡都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap worked. Do I get a receipt for this?
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp wɜɹkt du aɪ ɡɛt ə ɹɪˈsit fɚ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 碰一下成功了。這筆會附收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stapled to your copy, see you Monday then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstæpəld tə jɔɹ ˈkɑpi si ju ˈmʌndeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 會釘在您那張上，那就週一見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my copy? I thought email only?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt maɪ ˈkɑpi aɪ θɑt ˈimeɪl ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我那張？不是說只發郵件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You paid for two—email to HR, paper for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju peɪd fɚ tu ˈimeɪl tə eɪtʃ ɑɹ ˈpeɪpɚ fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 您付的是兩張——一張發人資，一張紙本留櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, right. Monday morning, front desk, got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɹaɪt ˈmʌndeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ fɹʌnt dɛs ɡɑɾ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 喔，對。週一早上，櫃台取，記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine a.m., ask for me, I'm Dana.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˌeɪ ˈɛm æsk fɚ mi aɪm ˈdeɪnə/
dialogue.zh: 早上九點整，找我，我叫 Dana。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dana, thanks. You saved me a week of stress.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪnə θæŋks ju seɪvd mi ə wik əv stɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: Dana，謝謝你。你幫我省下一整週的心驚膽跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it's just paper, but it guards jobs.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪts dʒʌst ˈpeɪpɚ bʌt ɪt ɡɑɹdz dʒɑbz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，不過是一張紙，但它守得住工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It guards my paycheck, that's the same thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡɑɹdz maɪ ˈpeɪtʃɛk ðæts ðə seɪm θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 它守住的是我的薪水，那是一回事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair! Rest up, and wash those hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɹɛst ʌp ænd wɑʃ ðoʊz hændz/
dialogue.zh: 說得對！多休息，手要常洗喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes doctor— I mean, you're not a doctor, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈdɑktɚ aɪ min jʊɹ nɑt ə ˈdɑktɚ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 遵命，醫——我是說，你又不是醫生，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Monday, feel better, take care.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈmʌndeɪ fil ˈbɛɾɚ teɪk kɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 週一見，好好休養，再見。

script.youtube_title: 【補開病假證明💼】「老闆要白紙黑字」📝證明上會寫什麼🗣️隱私費用自取一次講清✅🎧60句沉浸式英語聽力｜A Doctor's Note for Work
script.youtube_title_en: "My Boss Wants It in Writing" — Picking Up a Doctor's Note for Work
script.youtube_description:
「老闆要白紙黑字」——病癒返崗那天，怎麼請診所櫃台補開一張病假證明？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在診所的接待櫃台。

你會聽到：怎麼說明來意並確認看診日期；證明上到底寫什麼、為什麼不會寫診斷細節；工作限制那行怎麼加，例如兩週內禁止搬超過二十磅；第一張免費、複本收費怎麼付；還有趕在關門前要郵件還是週一自取、收據與備份的實用問句。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人辦事的自然語感：um、oh、hmm、ha、really。聽完你就會用：I need a doctor's note、Can I get two copies、Where do I sign、See you Monday。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"My boss wants it in writing" — the hardest part of being sick is the paperwork after. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a clinic front desk one afternoon, against a four o'clock closing.

You will hear: explaining the request and confirming the visit date; what a doctor's note actually says and why diagnosis details stay private; adding a work-restriction line, like no lifting over twenty pounds for two weeks; the first note is free but copies cost two dollars; and the email-versus-pickup choice when closing time is coming.

Everything stays in A2-level words with real desk-side rhythm: um, oh, hmm, ha, really. By the end you'll own phrases like I need a doctor's note, Can I get two copies, and Where do I sign.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
病了三天，回公司第一天，人資說要證明，你才知道忘記在診所拿單子？補開一張難不難、收不收費、今天內來不來得及？

這一集帶大家走進診所櫃台，從說明來意、核對看診日期，到寫上工作限制、拒絕透露診斷細節、選擇郵件或自取，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
💼 開口請求：I need a doctor's note for work.
📝 限制條款：I'll write: no lifting over twenty pounds.
🔒 隱私界線：No, we never write diagnosis details, privacy.
🖨️ 領取方式：So the email goes out today, still?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、oh、hmm 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這個剛病好的上班族跑一趟櫃台，下次你需要一張證明時，話就自己說得出來。

祝你返崗第一天順順利利。
